# Copilot Instructions

Follow, in this order:

1. `AGENTS.md` — source of truth for this project
2. `CONSTITUTION.md` — non-negotiables
3. `memory-bank/` — current focus, progress and decisions
4. `docs/` — architecture, domain context, data contract, testing strategy, threat model
5. `.github/skills/` — reusable procedures (task execution, debugging, review)

Do not invent domain rules. Use `TODO: verify` for unknowns. Keep changes minimal and tested.
